about: Every publication this project prepares, and where each one stands. docs/PUBLISHING-PAPERS.md explains the steps and the statuses; node tools/paper-check.js checks each entry against its files, and allows no email address in a paper's files except author.email. Update this file in the pull request that changes a status.

papers.title: Minimal Winding in the Self-Similar Collapse of Point Vortices
papers.note: Ready again (2026-09-25): its quality record, notes/QUALITY.md, is complete. The parts merged in from the alpha-model draft (Sections 4 to 8) had two recorded adversarial second readings, and their must-fix findings are fixed; release 2.1.0 of the companion carries the corrected paper. By the owner's decision (2026-09-25) arXiv is deferred until an endorsement; the Zenodo release 2.0.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.22963796, is the preprint of record and is in the data availability paragraph (papers/minimal-winding/submission/CHECKLIST.md). By the owner's decision (2026-09-25) the alpha-model draft (formerly alpha-winding) is merged into this paper, which also carries the computer-assisted proofs for four or more vortices; the title changed with the merge. Release 1.0.0 of the companion is archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22953035 (2026-09-25, before the central-vortex result and the merge); the paper cites the version DOI of release 2.0.0.

papers.title: Point-Vortex Collapse Without Rotation: A Cluster Mechanism, a Phase Diagram and a Continuum Limit
papers.note: Drafted in this repository by the owner's decision (2026-09-25), with the registry's author block as for minimal-winding, which it cites as its companion paper. O'Neil, Theor. Comput. Fluid Dyn. 24 (2010) 39-44, read in full (2026-09-25) and credited in Section 6; a second reader has checked the draft and its corrections are in. Ready for its first release in its companion repository, archived on Zenodo for a DOI (owner's decision, 2026-09-25); Aref et al., Vortex crystals (2003), read and cited; O'Neil 2013 read in summary only. No journal chosen yet.

papers.title: Stable Self-Similar Expansion of Four and Five Point Vortices and Confinement of Vortex Patches
papers.note: Drafted in this repository by the owner's decision (2026-09-25): computer-assisted proof that four and five Euler vortices have self-similarly expanding configurations that are stable modulo rotation and their family, linearly and nonlinearly (orbital asymptotic stability with the rate 1/size, the limit fixed by the energy, and an a priori estimate for forced motions), and Zbarsky's vortex-patch confinement theorem carried over to them. By the owner's decision (2026-09-25) it gets its first release in its companion repository, archived on Zenodo for a DOI, once its quality record is complete. Theorem 4 is proved in full in Appendix A (2026-09-26); independent readings of every section and of the programs are recorded in notes/QUALITY.md with their fixes; the owner signed off and the quality bar is met (2026-09-26). Zbarsky is cited by the section and equation numbers of arXiv:1912.10862v2; the published CMP version was not accessible. Kallyadan and Shukla, Phys. Rev. Fluids 7 (2022) 114701, is cited for background from its abstract. Leoncini, El Kettani and Ugalde, arXiv:2609.25989, read and cited. No journal chosen yet.

papers.title: A finite rank window cannot show that a neural population code satisfies the eigenspectrum smoothness bound
papers.note: Drafted in this repository by the owner's standing decision (2026-09-26): a methods note showing that exponents fitted over a finite rank window cannot test the eigenspectrum smoothness bound of Stringer et al. (2019); two in-project referee readings.

papers.title: Closed forms and sharp minima of ω t_c on three classical point-vortex collapse families
papers.note: Zero confirmed novel findings; a Zenodo record of its own is planned (identities/README.md), not a journal submission. Its links into this repository must be replaced before the record, since this repository may be private.
